events.text: Germaine of Foix became queen consort of King Ferdinand II of Aragon through their marriage.
events.subject: self
events.quote: queen consort of King Ferdinand II of Aragon from their marriage in 1506

events.text: Germaine of Foix's position as queen consort ended with Ferdinand's death.
events.subject: self

events.text: Germaine of Foix married Ferdinand in March 1506.
events.subject: self
events.quote: between Ferdinand ( aged 54 ) and Germaine ( aged 18 ) , took place in March 1506

events.text: Germaine gave birth to a son, John, Prince of Girona, on 3 May 1509.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Ferdinand and Germaine did have a son , John , Prince of Girona on 3 May 1509

events.text: Ferdinand died in 1516, leaving Germaine a widow.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Ferdinand died after two years of health problems in 1516 , leaving Germaine a widow

events.text: Germaine moved from Aragon to Castile to join Charles V's court in 1517.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Germaine moved from Aragon to Castile to join his court as well

events.text: Germaine gave birth in Valencia to a daughter, Isabel, on 20 August 1518.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 20 August 1518 , Germaine gave birth in Valencia to a daughter , Isabel

events.text: Germaine, Charles V, and Eleanor moved from Castile to Aragon.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Charles V , Germaine , and Charles Vs sister Eleanor moved from Castile to Aragon in 1519

events.text: Charles V arranged for Germaine to marry the margrave Johann of Brandenburg-Ansbach.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Charles V arranged for Germaine to marry the margrave Johann of Brandenburg-Ansbach

events.text: Germaine left Spain to travel with Charles V to Germany, where she was married.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Germaine left Spain to travel with Charles V to Germany , where she was married

events.text: Charles V appointed the couple jointly viceroys of Valencia.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1523 Charles V appointed the couple jointly viceroys of Valencia

events.text: Germaine signed a pardon that officially ended the persecution of all former participants in the rebellion.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In December 1524 , Germaine signed a pardon that officially ended the persecution

events.subject: self
events.quote: Germaine died on 15 October 1536 in Liria

events.text: Germaine was interred in the Monastery of San Miguel de los Reyes.
events.subject: self
events.object: Monastery of San Miguel de los Reyes
events.quote: and was interred in the Monastery of San Miguel de los Reyes
